entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-07-30
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Aspire run-session server: SendMessageAsync over-releases _webSocketAccess on cancellation, permitting concurrent WebSocket sends #55546
  • Stop running build jobs on official builds #55544
  • mojibake in autocompletion via `dotnet completions script pwsh` #55541
  • Emit a warning when `IncludeAllContentForSelfExtract` is enabled #55535

Closed

  • [NETSDKE2E][Regression] With 11.0.100-preview.7.26376.106.exe installed, wasm-tools workload installation failed with 11.0.100-preview.7.26376.106 of package microsoft.netcore.app.runtime.browser-wasm.msi.-x64 not found #55491
  • Reduce PR validation time by conditionally filtering tests based on changed files #55203
  • TestTemplatesCG fails in internal official scheduled build with MSB4057 (RunTests target missing) #55496
  • UWP XBF files lose subdirectory paths in resources.pri when UseArtifactsOutput is enabled #53556

PullRequests

Created

  • Stop running build jobs on official check-in CI runs #55547
  • [automated] Merge branch 'main' => 'release/dnup' #55545
  • [release/10.0.3xx] Fix DownloadBlobAsync_RetriesOnFailure digest validation #55543
  • Add more tests for `CA2007` rule for `await using` and `await foreach` cases #55542
  • Fix platform guard analysis with call-site support #55540
  • Onboard the Build Failure Analysis agentic workflow #55539
  • Fix fix-all correctness and authoring conformance across the .NET analyzers #55538
  • Fix BlazorWebAssemblyDiagnosticsEnabled so it can be set from a .csproj #55537
  • Bump MSTest.Sdk from 4.4.0-preview.26376.8 to 4.4.0-preview.26379.6 #55536
    dependencies, dependabot: main

Merged

  • Add a shared fix-all provider that fixes a document through one editor #55533
  • Update link to ASP.NET Core tools #53278
    Area-AspNetCore
  • Improve `dotnetup` adx dashboard to better show failure rates #55156
  • Add a skill for authoring .NET analyzers #55510
  • Update merge flow to remove 10.0.3xx #55534
  • [automated] Merge branch 'main' => 'release/dnup' #55530
    Approved to merge
  • Unify internal CI matrix and refactor CG mode to SDL mode #55500
  • Add ILLink conditional test scope to reduce PR validation time #55522
  • Report MSBuild errors from `dotnet test` device deploy and run-argument builds #55524
  • Fix UWP XBF files losing subdirectory paths in resources.pri when UseArtifactsOutput is enabled #53867

Updated

  • [release/10.0.1xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #55191
  • Seed CLI telemetry session IDs from CI workflow context #54447
    Area-Telemetry
  • Add `dotnetup` Channel Intent Docs #55390
  • Suppress advertising manifest messages unless verbosity is diagnostic #55276
  • Migrate to custom OTel Exporter in `dotnetup` to prevent perf delay and data loss #55421
  • Replace nuget.org feed URLs with packagefeedproxy in tests #55463
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Port template engine Helix consolidation (PR #53546) #55528
  • [release/10.0.3xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #55455
  • Add --prerelease flag to dotnet new install #55503
  • Add targeted test workflow for agents #55532
  • Fix repeatable attribute matching in ApiCompat #55448
    Area-ApiCompat
  • Enable cached file-based run in Native AOT CLI #55529
    Area-run-file
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0.1xx' => 'release/10.0.3xx' #55486
    Area-Watch
  • Enable MSBuild-backed commands in the Native AOT CLI #55497
  • Add /parallel-audit agentic workflow, bump testfx, adopt [ResourceLock] #55527
  • [release/11.0.1xx-preview7] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #55481
    11.0-preview7
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #55512
